limitations: The reference checks location of an explicitly classified set. It does not determine assertion purpose or prove a suite collected/executed the tests.
The source comparison samples two independently inspected repository-policy modules per repository; it is not a complete classification of every test module.
Renaming test nodes invalidates old source-qualified receipts; regenerate/review real collection evidence and retain required coverage, rather than claiming old receipts apply.
The test_*.py convention is for the observed Python policy-test surfaces. Other runner languages require a deliberate equivalent adapter, not forced Python rewrites.
An exception reason is input for human review, not machine authorization.
